description: Agent Automotive: submit a registration document with the vehicle record: the registration with its issuer, plate, VIN, model year, make, model, each registered owner as printed, the day issued and the expiry; the vehicle record with the same fields, the expiry of record and the status (active, expired, suspended or cancelled). The signed report gives the registration and the record, the plate and VIN on each side, the owners printed and of record with those unrecorded or left off, and the expiry printed against the expiry of record, and counts them, and names a mismatched registration: a record that shows the registration expired, suspended or cancelled, another plate, VIN or registered owner, and a printed expiry later than the record’s; then another year, make or model, an earlier printed expiry, a registration dated after its own expiry and another issuer wording, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No plate, VIN, owner or expiry on either side leaves the registration unverified. Plates and VINs match by their letters and digits without case or spacing, and owner names in either order when written last name first. This reads a vehicle registration against the vehicle record: wever_agent-registry-check reads an agent registry or inventory against the deployment and usage lists it should cover, which shares only the word, and wever_vendor-identity-check reads a vendor’s registration number among its identity evidence, not a vehicle’s plate. Verdict auto_registration_mismatched, auto_registration_partial, auto_registration_unverified or auto_registration_matched. POST /api/auto-registration-check. Reads the vehicle paperwork supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only, with no mechanical diagnosis, safety judgment, vehicle valuation or legal advice on title, registration or lease terms, and the paperwork stays in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Automotive reads supplied vehicle paperwork for consistency between documents, each document identified by its VIN: a vehicle listing, a title, an odometer statement, a service or repair invoice, an inspection report, a recall completion record, a registration and a vehicle lease. Beside it, wever_warranty-check reads a warranty claim against the warranty terms for any product, vehicles included, for DiligenceOps, and warranty claims stay there; the Agent Real Estate checks read property documents identified by parcel and address, not vehicle documents; the Agent Insurance checks such as wever_insurance-coverage-check read insurance policies, vehicle policies included, and coverage terms stay there; and wever_logistics-carrier-check reads a shipping carrier’s billed charges and terms, not a car, and shares only the letters. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-automotive-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-automotive/.
